html:
Ring Size Chart – Find Your Exact Ring Size Quickly

The free ring‑size chart shows 37 sizes in 5 systems. Use the on‑page widget to confirm your size.

How to Use the Chart

  1. Open the Ring Size page.
  2. Pick the sizing system you use (U.S., UK, European, Japanese, or Chinese).
  3. Compare your finger or an existing ring to the chart.
  4. For extra precision, click the Ring‑Sizer widget on the page to measure directly.

What You Get

  • Free chart with 37 ring sizes in 5 systems.
  • No account or payment needed – the tool is $0.
  • Part of a library of 250+ reference pages (gemstone, metal, and diamond calculators).
  • The free widget shows “Powered by CaratBase”.
  • Save your size on your device with My Vault at no cost.

FAQ

How accurate is the chart for different countries? It lists exact conversions for U.S., UK, European, Japanese, and Chinese sizes, so you can trust the numbers for those systems.

Can I save my size for later? Yes. Use My Vault to store the size on your device without any cost.

Is this an official appraisal of my ring? No. The chart and widget provide sizing information only; they are not a licensed appraisal and do not buy or sell jewelry.

What if I need a custom widget for my jeweler site? Upgrade to Widget Pro for $12 / month per domain. It removes the attribution line and adds a custom call‑to‑action.

Where can I see other jewelry calculators? Explore the full toolbox at CaratBase Tools, including diamond value, gold price, and gemstone calculators.
